name: Mode Sonnet
description: 75 percent aluminum board from Mode Designs with hotswap PCBs and a 5.5-degree typing angle. Mode's Mounting Block System captures plate tabs in EPU41 polymer blocks rather than a silicone gasket strip, though the hobby (and this catalog) files it under gasket-mount for the soft, balanced feel it produces. Plate options run POM (stock), aluminum, carbon fiber, and copper. Mid-priced for the segment; ships with a brass weight option.
